newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Nine dead in Taiwan chemical factory blaze.
newsitem.headline: Nine dead in Taiwan chemical factory blaze.

text.p: Fire swept through a chemical complex in northern Taiwan, killing nine people, most of them firefighters, and injuring more than 100, police said on Tuesday.
"We have discovered nine bodies. Six of them are firemen," a police officer at northern Taoyuan County told Reuters by telephone.
The cause of fire late on Monday was yet to be determined.
An initial investigation showed the blaze started in the Yung Hsing Chemical Factory, which makes resin, and triggered a series of explosions in adjacent factories, the officer said.
There are several textile and petrochemical factories in the industrial complex, the police said.
